title: A left menu about the open project
text: The left menu now centres on the project you have open: a Project section names it and lists its views (Canvas, Table, Queue, Parked, Archive). A Configure section follows, with Appearance (light or dark, motion) opening right inside the menu, then Settings, the controls and Give Feedback. The old Preferences dialog is gone: agent rules live under Configure agents › Rules, and About Seismic is the last section of Settings. The same layout shows in the desktop app, in narrow windows and on the phone.
chapters: Help and feedback below a line

more.title: Project pill beside the docked menu
more.text: With the left menu docked, the project pill stays at the start of the project, so switching projects and adding a new one is always one click away. It slides along as the menu is shown or hidden. Escape on a page of the docked menu, such as Appearance, now goes back to the menu and leaves the view underneath open.
chapters: The project pill beside the docked menu
Escape goes back in the menu

more.title: Appearance choices with icons, stacked in a narrow menu
more.text: The Appearance page in the left menu sets light or dark and motion, each choice with its icon: a monitor for Match system, a sun and a moon for light and dark, fast-forward and pause for motion. In a menu narrower than 300 pixels the choices stack one under another, so every option stays in view; widened again, they return to one row.
